request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER

layers.text: Recolour only the goblin's skin: the yellow skin of his face, ears and hands becomes a mid-tone olive green, colour #8a952f with #495508 shadows; not yellow, and the face stays clearly visible. Do not touch the wolf. Keep everything else exactly the same: the brown leather cap, his clothes and strap, the grey wolf's head, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
